note: The only spending limit. Ceiling = account_total_inr - safety_buffer_inr, measured on data/spend_ledger.json. If console_spent_inr is set (with console_spent_date, YYYY-MM-DD), remaining = ceiling - console_spent_inr - ledger spend recorded after that date. How much one run may do is config/growth.json (target_papers_per_run, per_run_cost_cap_inr). See backend/app/extraction/money.py and docs/OPERATIONS.md.
